decision: Use a disposable, repository-scoped, one-job Ubuntu VM runner only for the protected Supabase standby readiness job that needs outbound IPv6.

ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend: disposable runner Ansible hardening and tooling role
ramideltoro/nutsnews: regression guard rejecting unapproved supabase-standby-ipv6 label use

excluded_hosts.reason: The production backend host contains production runtime state, SSH trust, backend credentials, Docker networks, persistent disks, and sensitive service reachability. Public-repository workflow code must not execute on it.

vm_profile.size: Basic shared CPU, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, 25 GiB SSD
vm_profile.credential_policy: No production/backend credentials, no database URLs, no provider credentials, no private keys except the temporary operator SSH key and short-lived GitHub runner token.

runner_model.label_note: Labels are routing selectors. Authorization is enforced by workflow triggers, branch/ref guards, protected environments, repository settings, and post-job teardown.

trust_controls.environment: supabase-standby with required reviewer and main-only deployment branch policy
trust_controls.github_token: contents: read unless a workflow explicitly grants less/more for a reviewed need
trust_controls.pull_requests: No pull_request, pull_request_target, push, schedule, or workflow_call job may target supabase-standby-ipv6.
trust_controls.runner_user: Non-root github-runner account, locked password, no sudo/admin group, no passwordless sudoers drop-in.
trust_controls.host_isolation: No Docker socket, no production mounts, no cloud metadata credentials, no backend private network, no production SSH keys.
trust_controls.cleanup: Collect redacted diagnostics, confirm deregistration, destroy/wipe VM after the one allowed job.

threat_model.threat: malicious PR or workflow code requests the public self-hosted label
controls: repository settings require strongest available external-contributor workflow approval
main branch/ruleset requires review and green checks before workflow changes land
app regression scans reject supabase-standby-ipv6 outside the approved manual workflow
the runner is registered only after controls pass and only for one job

threat_model.threat: runner persistence or reuse after compromise
controls: the VM is destroyed/wiped after the run
stale GitHub runner records are removed through the protected backend workflow

threat_model.threat: secret exposure through logs, summaries, artifacts, or local disk
controls: short-lived registration/removal token is never committed, logged, or persisted
Supabase values live only in the protected app environment
preflight and readiness probes print only boolean/safe metadata
diagnostics are reviewed and redacted before retention

threat_model.threat: unexpected network reachability from runner to production/backend systems
controls: dedicated VM is not on backend Docker networks or private host networks
only DNS, HTTP/HTTPS for GitHub/packages, NTP, and optional redacted IPv6 TCP/5432 are allowed

threat_model.threat: runner label is mistaken for authorization
controls: ADR states labels are routing selectors only
workflow and repository controls remain the authorization boundary
manual protected environment approval happens before standby secrets are read

rollback: Do not register a new runner.
Stop the systemd service if it exists.
Remove the repository runner from GitHub or run the protected remove mode.
Revert ramideltoro/nutsnews .github/workflows/supabase-standby-readiness.yml readiness.runs-on to ubuntu-latest if the IPv6 runner path is abandoned.

If selected-actions breaks a reviewed existing workflow, temporarily restore allowed_actions to all while keeping the source-controlled SHA-pinning guard, then add the missing exact allow pattern and re-enable selected-actions.

If the solo-maintainer review requirement blocks emergency repair, use GitHub's documented branch-protection admin flow to make a narrow temporary rollback, then restore the reviewed branch-protection baseline and record the exception.
Use the Supabase IPv4 add-on decision path only through a separate reviewed issue.
safe_evidence: whether a global IPv6 route exists
whether DNS AAAA resolution passed without printing the hostname
